title: Then going through some small strange motions
excerpt: A moderate incline runs towards the foot of Maybury Hill, and down this we clattered with warm aroma drifting into the crisp morning stillness.
author: Henrietta Ross
content:
A moderate incline runs towards the foot of Maybury Hill, and down this we clattered with warm aroma drifting into the crisp morning stillness. In coffee alchemy, extraction is an exact mathematical and sensorial discipline.

The Golden Viscosity of Dawn

Nine bars of pressure pushing water at ninety-three degrees Celsius through eighteen grams of finely milled Ethiopian heirloom beans produces a stream that looks like melted mahogany ribbon.

The ritual of the morning extraction is more than caffeine delivery; it is a grounding meditation before the demands of design and production begin.
